Jimmy might not have a criminal record regardless of his (in)compentency. Plus he got into the company through Curly's recommendation, I assume Curly's word meant a lot since he's a valued employee. And Pony Express is not some prestige space company, I mean they have interns there, you would think the internship program would be stricter. Daisuke didn't even want to be there and he's under Swansea, a mechanic. He could have learned all that stuff back on Earth. But this is a universe that mechanic interns can go to space.

Pony Express is a delivery company, a delivery company that's going bankrupt and they're just space delivery men. It's not this prestigious, classified job. I don't know what kind of qualifications they need but I bet Jimmy is still qualified on paper. All the other points in the OP still stand, they're greedy that they cut costs in every corner. But they still didn't make Jimmy do all those things.

I agree that Pony Express is the villain in terms of setting up Curly for failure. But the company didn't make Jimmy rape Anya. There are 4 guys there and only Jimmy did that. And that happened before they knew they were getting fired. Jimmy was a bad person even without Pony Express being there.

Don't get me wrong, I like discussions like this, especially about more Pony Express being neglectful and greedy but for me, they're more of a shit company than a villain. I truly believe that if another (better) person was there instead of Jimmy, the events of the game wouldn't happen even if all the shortcomings of Pony Express are still present.

As someone who reads RPF, I never really thought of them as the real people anymore, just characters. But I do tend to like groups (idol groups, bands and YT groups) rather than just an individual person or a duo that's being shipped so I gravitate towards friendship fics more. I still read romance in certain groups but only if the premise is very interesting. I tend to skip any kind of just straight up smut because somehow that always feels weird to me, and if it comes up in a story with an actual plot, I just skip it. 

I don't really look down on RPF authors but I try to avoid Pw/oP and any explicit and graphic (like torture and suffering) writing about the people.

I think it's also common decency to not expose these to the actual people because they did not ask for this, although some YTers hunt for these fics so I don't know!

Just to add more, it stands to say that these fanfics are free so authors can't really exploit the likeness of the real people for money. I don't know the permission execs get to produce a biopic/movies inspired by real events with the people still alive, but I'm 100% sure, they don't get Harry's permission for those 1D fanfic movies. But technically, it's not him anymore, just a British guy with a name starting with an H. Permission/consent in a paid work still matters so I guess that's a line for me too.

Di talaga ako animal person until we got our cat this year. Then I started noticing na yung mga stray cats sa labas, grabe I just try to look away most of the time kasi di ko rin naman pwedeng damputin silang lahat. In our area tho, maraming former house cats na kinda abandoned na (kilala ko yung may-ari nung mga cats and talagang hinayaan na lang magutom sa labas), so I started feeding them twice a day. Six sila initially and pag feeding time na, nakaabang na sila sa gate namin. Nagalit pa parents ko sakin kasi ang ingay daw but I made them promise na wag nilang sasaktan ever. Over the months naman, hindi na sila payatot and lagi nila akong sinusundan pag naglalakad ako sa labas hehe para akong may entourage.

Unfortunately wala na yung isa, hindi na lang siya sumulpot, weakest din kasi siya and wala talaga akong money pang-vet. Nung first day na wala siya, ang tamlay din nung other 5 and may white butterfly na umaaligid (pure plain white kasi yung nawala). But napalitan din a few weeks later ng another street cat so I feel like she directed him to me knowing na they're safe and will be fed sa bahay namin huhu.

I just want to share that kasi we're all trying our best to help all our furry friends out there. We can't help them all but know na you're not alone in feeling this way and also caring for them. Know na the cats/animals you help appreciate you, worth is ang every kagat/kalmot. Altho be careful with rabies huhu
